title: Cecrops
summary: Raleigh names Cecrops in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The Athenian king he names with Moses. Not Cecrops II, who already has a record from the chronological table. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter III, §. I, sig. 173b–174a
reign.note: Body intake. A reign length for the Athenian Cecrops named with Moses. Not the 40 yeeres of Cecrops the second. The table cell was illegible and was not imported. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.

free_source_links.locator: Book I, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, sig. 95b
